scope: Public development, declared handler entry and supplied fixed-ref source only; no target execution or deployment assertion.

dimensions.behavior: Whether the explanation correctly describes the reachable authorization behavior or a justified unknown under the stated premises.
dimensions.conclusion: Whether the canonical conclusion and structured observed or conditional decision match the evaluator-only oracle. A correct explanation with a contradictory canonical label is not full.
dimensions.binding: Whether caller identity, selected protected resource and any distinct source object are bound to the right objects.
dimensions.control: Whether the decisive authorization check, exception or missing check is identified at the correct layer.
dimensions.effect: Whether the guarded operation and its ordering relative to the control are accurately identified.
dimensions.branches: Whether task-required positive, negative or conditional branches are distinguished without inventing runtime facts.
dimensions.citations: Whether exact supplied-source citations support the material control, binding and effect claims; citation presence alone is insufficient.
dimensions.materialClosure: Separately record whether baseline/prepared source visibly includes the decisive dependency and whether the answer acknowledges a named preparation gap. This does not by itself decide semantic full credit.

fullRule: Full requires correct behavior and canonical conclusion plus adequate binding, control, effect, requested branches and supporting citations, with no material unsupported claim. Correct behavior with a contradictory conclusion is partial at most.
blindReview: Packets identify case and evidence layer but omit Markdown/DSL arm and unit ID. Reviewers must not read review-map.json before recording scores.
sourceOfTruth: oracle.json was frozen before AJ analysis calls; reviewers check its premises and decisive lines against packet source and fixed-ref public source. Disputes retain reasons and sensitivity instead of changing the oracle after seeing results.
